title: Asparagus seedling 491975: 14 of 20 input amounts sit on the wrong row

datasets.name: Asparagus seedling, open field, at production site

observation: 14 of its 20 technosphere and land rows carry the amount, with its pedigree comment, of a different row of the report's Figure 6 (*Life cycle assessment of strawberry and asparagus production*, Kägi et al., 2022). `Pesticide unspecified` reads 0.04 kg per seedling against the figure's 3.35E-06 kg. That one row is 89 % of the seedling's GWP100 in the workbook (0.392 kg CO₂-eq/p; about 0.024 with the figure's assignment) and 22–37 % of its three consumers, `Asparagus, conventional` 435703 (CH), 378451 (PE) and 202096 (MX).
method: Measured on the ecoSpold XML of 2025 v2 and 2026 v1 against the report figure, row by row by amount, and on the LCIA workbook; filed 31 October 2026. Not yet re-measured by a second person.

next.action: A second person repeats the measurement on BAFU's release files. Then the finding is reported to BAFU.
